plainText:
Shōko Tsuda (Japanese: 津田匠子 Tsuda Shōko) is a Japanese voice actor for .

==Biography==
Tsuda was born on January 30, 1963 in and became a voice actor as an adult. Tsuda joined during , voicing several characters, most notably Shelly from Team Aqua. Years later, Tsuda returned in , voicing Professor Magnolia.

==Pokémon roles==
===Animation===
==== ====
=====Humans=====
======Major======
Shelly
Professor Magnolia

======Minor======
Kimie

==Other non-Pokémon roles==
Takki (The Twelve Kingdoms)
Chris (Astro Boy)
Sanada Kyouko (Gad Guard)
Johanna (Emma: A Victorian Romance Second Act)
Nina Lutz (Nodame Cantabile: Finale)
